title: December 1978 normalization primary-record check
episode: December 4–15, 1978; retrospective contextual memorandum of December 19, 1980

sources.title: Woodcock report of meeting with Han Nien-lung
sources.publication: Published FRUS 1977–1980, Volume XIII, China, document 159
sources.source_type: Contemporary US record published in FRUS
sources.reading_scope: 18 numbered paragraphs and 16 editorial/source notes; all read.
sources.limitations: The Chinese draft and US instructions are separately referenced, not supplied in full. American record of translated Chinese positions.

sources.title: Brzezinski–Chai conversation memorandum
sources.publication: Published FRUS 1977–1980, Volume XIII, China, document 163
sources.source_type: Contemporary US record published in FRUS
sources.reading_scope: Complete meeting record and sole source note read.
sources.limitations: Covering note infers probable Chinese receipt before scheduling; no Chinese transmission record.

sources.title: Policy Review Committee science-and-technology conclusions
sources.publication: Published FRUS 1977–1980, Volume XIII, China, document 164
sources.source_type: Contemporary US record published in FRUS
sources.reading_scope: Complete conclusions, participants and two source notes read. Contextual acquisition; not used to explain normalization closure.
sources.limitations: Technical interagency discussion is not the December12 instruction to Woodcock. PRC here means Policy Review Committee, not the People’s Republic.

sources.title: Report of Policy Review Committee science-and-technology meeting
sources.publication: Published FRUS 1977–1980, Volume XIII, China, document 165
sources.source_type: Contemporary US record published in FRUS
sources.reading_scope: Complete report and three source notes read. Contextual acquisition, not used in central reconstruction.
sources.limitations: Shorter report differs in emphasis from committee conclusions; not a normalization negotiating instruction.

sources.title: Woodcock report of meeting with Deng Xiaoping
sources.publication: Published FRUS 1977–1980, Volume XIII, China, document 166
sources.source_type: Contemporary US record published in FRUS
sources.reading_scope: 44 numbered paragraphs and 19 source/editorial notes; all read.
sources.limitations: Reported transcript, with Carter annotations reproduced in editorial notes. Underlying December12 instruction and December7 draft not fully reproduced. Paragraph41 lacks no in its publicity sentence; note19 records Carter’s correction. Do not treat that sentence literally as a decision to publicize.

sources.title: Woodcock assessment of Deng meeting
sources.publication: Published FRUS 1977–1980, Volume XIII, China, document 167
sources.source_type: Contemporary US record published in FRUS
sources.reading_scope: 14 numbered paragraphs and five source notes; all read.
sources.limitations: Same witness and meeting as166, not independent corroboration. Domestic vulnerability and likely acceptance are the diplomat’s assessments.

sources.title: Woodcock report of second closing meeting with Deng
sources.publication: Published FRUS 1977–1980, Volume XIII, China, document 168
sources.source_type: Contemporary US record published in FRUS
sources.reading_scope: 13 numbered paragraphs, reproduced Chinese statement draft in US record, and 13 notes; all read.
sources.limitations: Full December14 US instructions and separately transmitted communiqué not acquired; attribution of misunderstanding remains Woodcock’s.

sources.title: Woodcock to Brzezinski on arms sales and public statements
sources.publication: Published FRUS 1977–1980, Volume XIII, China, document 169
sources.source_type: Contemporary US record published in FRUS
sources.reading_scope: Five numbered paragraphs and six notes, including quoted Washington response; all read.
sources.limitations: Forecast of future objections is not later performance evidence; US attribution of Chinese domestic embarrassment is an inference.

sources.title: Woodcock report of third closing meeting with Deng
sources.publication: Published FRUS 1977–1980, Volume XIII, China, document 170
sources.source_type: Contemporary US record published in FRUS
sources.reading_scope: Complete six-paragraph summary and four notes read.
sources.limitations: Full transcript identified as cable237 not acquired. This summary is not that transcript.

sources.title: Brzezinski instruction on explaining the US arms-sales position
sources.publication: Published FRUS 1977–1980, Volume XIII, China, document 172
sources.source_type: Contemporary US record published in FRUS
sources.reading_scope: Complete instruction and three notes including Woodcock response quotation; all read.
sources.limitations: Published response formula contains defensive ABM. No original scan checked to resolve wording; no inference about ABM transfers or silent quotation correction made.

sources.title: Oksenberg retrospective memorandum on China policy since mid-1978
sources.publication: Published FRUS 1977–1980, Volume XIII, China, document 327
sources.reading_scope: Complete substantive memorandum and 20 notes read; later 1979–1980 sections not substantively audited against their source chains.
sources.limitations: Retrospective internal participant assessment defending NSC role; contains undeclassified omissions. Its six sessions list has seven dates; transmission/causation claims remain distinct from contemporary inference.

sources.title: 中华人民共和国和美利坚合众国关于建立外交关系的联合公报
sources.publication: MFA repost in 2022 web directory; document dated 1979-01-01
sources.source_type: Official Chinese-language republication of common communiqué
sources.reading_scope: Complete substantive communiqué read; site navigation excluded.
sources.limitations: Final common instrument, not independent Chinese record of bargaining or a signed facsimile.

sources.title: Vance and Brzezinski to Unger, December 15, 1978, FRUS 1977–1980 XIII, document 171
sources.source_type: Contemporary US message, subsequently selected and published in FRUS
sources.reading_scope: Complete message, enclosed US statement and joint communiqué, and both source notes read.
sources.reuse: Same preserved FRUS171 version as SOL-COR03; not independent evidence.

source_independence: FRUS selection republishes US messages, a meeting memorandum, annotations and a retrospective account from overlapping participants. These records are not 13 independent witnesses. Chinese communiqué is a second language/version of the common instrument, not Chinese internal minutes.
preservation_policy: HTML originals outside Git; temporary text extraction used for reading; metadata and original analysis in repository.

WH81595, December 12 instructions, and WH81579, December 7 US draft: Outside the System File, Box47, Outgoing Cables12/78.
WH81602 and WH81605, December 14 instructions: Oksenberg Subject File, Box45, respective December14–17 and December13 meeting folders.
Cable237, complete December 15 Woodcock–Deng transcript: Outside the System File, Box47, Incoming Cables12/78.
Contemporaneous Chinese minutes, exchanged draft originals and internal authorization records.
review_status: Bounded independent review completed 2026-09-15: complete FRUS 166–170 and 172, relevant passages of 159/163/327 and consequential claims checked. Refined distinction between Deng’s knowledge of the December 11 exchange, uncertain receipt before meeting scheduling, and unproved causal priming. This is not a second complete reading of all 13 records.
